best_idea: A duel hit chance that climbs in fixed bands, where each extra band costs more gap than the last, clamped between a floor and a ceiling, and a seeded balance run that checks the ladder.
decision_why: Our duel roll is server-side, and a banded ladder with a growing per-band cost gives designers a visible, testable curve with a hard cap for one-on-one and many-on-one; the offline Perl tool is not adopted, only the shape and a seeded balance test.
acceptance: A server test with a seeded RNG: equal attack and defence gives the base chance, each band adds its fixed step, every gap from -50 to +50 units stays inside the min and max clamp, and 10,000 seeded duels give the same hit count on every run.
